reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified 4C as a water-supply fault immediately, asked the single sensible question about recent plumbing work, interpreted the screwdriver-slot valve orientation correctly as closed, and guided the homeowner to a confirmed fix with appropriate power-isolation advice for the filter and a sensible post-fix leak check.
